newsitem.title: USA: Inhale Therapeutic stake held by Soros.
newsitem.headline: Inhale Therapeutic stake held by Soros.

text.p: A group led by international financier George Soros said Tuesday it holds a 5.5 percent stake in Inhale Therapeutic Systems or 750,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $13.5 millon to purchase the shares relating to a stock purchase agreement dated January 28 and hold the shares for investment purposes.
Inhale, based in Palo Alto, Calif., develops a pulmonary drug delivery system applicable to a wide range of peptides, proteins and other macromolecuoles currently delivered by injection.
